∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)),
      0 < labels.length →
        ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
          (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
          (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
          Measurable rows →
            (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
              (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n labels x start rows answer →
                  ∀ (j : Fin n) (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                          ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.couponWaiting n labels x start (rows ω)
                              (fun a r => answer a r ω) j u) ∂↑P ≤
                        1 + ↑(min (↑j + 1) labels.length) / ↑u
